proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Map each workload/data class, AI inference path, backup, support access, subprocessor and telephony dependency for every required country.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Data-flow diagram, DPA, subprocessor list, support model, telephony-country matrix and contract commitments.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Any mandatory workload requires an unacceptable geography, jurisdiction, support-access path or fragmented architecture.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which exact data, AI and support paths leave the buyer's required jurisdiction, and under what operational scenario?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Buyer country list, data classification, regulatory/contractual requirements and target architecture.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: European sovereignty is a strength, but buyer workload may require non-European data, operations, telephony or support.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Every mandatory workload meets location, access, support and compliance requirements with documented ownership.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Load the proposed topology to buyer peak plus agreed growth headroom across voice, digital, queues, agents, supervisors, WFM/reporting and integrations.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Load metrics, queue/routing logs, API errors/limits, supervisor views, reporting/WFM results and recovery timeline.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Any undocumented limit, material partitioning requirement or degraded recovery changes the intended operating model.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: At what point does the proposed tenant/topology need partitioning, and what operational functions stop behaving as one system?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Buyer peak/concurrency model, routing design, representative channels/integrations and agreed surge factor.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Current public evidence does not prove extreme per-tenant scale, concurrency, queue/object or API headroom.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: No unacceptable routing degradation, dropped work, hidden quota, admin/reporting fragmentation or recovery failure.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Configure a representative WFM + QM/CI + Case + VA + core CCaaS workflow and trace identity, data, admin, incidents and upgrades across each module.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Architecture map, admin screens, data flow, support RACI, incident drill and release dependencies.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Hidden product boundary, duplicate administration, inconsistent identity/data, support ping-pong or unrecoverable cross-module failure.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which 'Puzzel' capabilities are operated on a distinct acquired/partner control plane, and who owns a cross-module incident?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Exact SKUs, target integrations, named support teams and representative user/queue data.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: The broad ecosystem contains acquired and third-party lineage that may create different admin/data/support boundaries.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Buyer can identify authoritative admin/data/control plane and incident owner for every step; cross-product workflow remains coherent.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Run wrong-identity, stale-data, connector-timeout, duplicate-request, partial-success, denied-permission and rollback/repair scenarios.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Agentic logs, system transaction IDs, permission logs, customer-visible response, human-handoff and compensation/rollback evidence.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Any silent, duplicate or unauthorized business-state change, missing audit, or unrecoverable partial state.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Show a failed agentic action from customer request through system-of-record state and final repair.
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Sandbox system of record, test identities/permissions, representative action tools and reversible transactions.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Agentic actions are current capability, but transaction integrity for consequential actions is not fully public.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Unauthorized actions are blocked; duplicate execution is prevented; partial failures are visible; audit is complete; required confirmation and repair paths work.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Inventory current/legacy components, migrate a representative Chat/digital workflow and validate routing, history, identity, reporting and integrations after cutover.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Migration inventory, mapping, before/after tests, archived/exported data and decommission runbook.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Feature regression, orphaned history/config, unsupported integration or prolonged dual-admin dependency exceeds buyer tolerance.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which legacy components will still exist six months after go-live, and what must the customer maintain during coexistence?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Installed-product/version inventory, legacy APIs/config, test channels, historical data and regression suite.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Installed estates may carry migration debt from retired Chat or older acquired products/configurations.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Target state preserves required functionality/data and has a documented decommission/rollback path.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Create two client programs with shared agents and separate routing, data, recordings, knowledge, AI, WFM/QM, integrations, reporting and usage; inject a client-specific fault.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Access tests, recordings, reports, WFM/QM outputs, AI context, usage records and incident logs.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Cross-client data/policy bleed, unacceptable admin duplication, shared blast radius or unusable cost attribution.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Can one agent serve two clients without exposing either client's data, policy, knowledge, AI context or usage?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Two client datasets/policies/integrations, shared agents and chargeback requirements.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Outsourcer references do not prove hard multi-client isolation or pooled-agent economics.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: No cross-client leakage; policies remain isolated; shared-agent workflow is usable; failure remains contained; usage can be attributed.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Rebuild five representative voice/digital routing scenarios including priority, skill, timeout, overflow, transfer and callback.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Routing configuration, event/queue logs, agent/supervisor results.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Priority inversion, lost context, unsupported rule or hidden custom-service requirement.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which routing requirement cannot be administered natively by the buyer after go-live?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Buyer decision table, queues/skills and test contacts.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Routing claims should be proven against the buyer's real SLA/skill/priority logic.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Every path preserves correct priority, context and fallback under normal and no-agent states.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Load historical multichannel demand, forecast, schedule multi-skill agents, simulate intraday change and measure adherence.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Forecasts, staffing requirements, schedules, adherence and change logs.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Required channel/workload is unsupported or integration/admin effort defeats intended operating model.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which work types or queue mappings require manual workarounds or separate control planes?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Representative history, SLAs, skills, shrinkage, shifts and source mappings.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: WFM breadth is current but buyer workload and cross-product architecture must be validated.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Forecast/schedule/adherence supports buyer workload physics and admins can operate without disproportionate manual work.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Run a buyer-curated truth set through automated and manual QA, compare disagreement, calibration and coaching workflow; separately test written-channel requirements.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Score distributions, human/AI disagreements, calibration decisions, coaching and channel-coverage evidence.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Unacceptable disagreement, no appeal/calibration path or buyer assumes automated digital coverage that is not actually delivered.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which interaction types are automatically scored today, and what still depends on manual or another module?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Representative calls/chat/email, buyer rubric, trained human graders and compliance examples.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Automated 100% voice scoring does not prove rubric validity or digital-QA parity.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Scoring is explainable/reviewable, calibration works and current channel coverage matches buyer requirements.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Extract calls, chats, emails, agent states and key interaction variables to buyer BI/lake and reconcile against platform reporting.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: SQL extracts, reconciliation report, schema, latency measurements and retention/export plan.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Missing event type, material mismatch, unacceptable latency or proprietary dependency blocks buyer use.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which data cannot be exported in raw form with stable identifiers and usable event timing?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Representative multi-channel period, SQL access, buyer BI target and known totals.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Raw Data improves portability only if completeness, timeliness and exit format meet buyer needs.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Required events arrive within acceptable latency, reconcile to source totals and remain usable independent of UI reports.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Break Salesforce/Dynamics or another critical connector plus one cross-product Puzzel dependency and execute detection, escalation, degraded mode and recovery.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Alerts/logs, support tickets, API errors, recovery and reconciliation evidence.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Support ping-pong, silent failure, data divergence or unrecoverable workflow.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Who owns the customer outcome when core PCC is available but an acquired/partner module or CRM connector is down?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Production-like connector, support contacts, logs and failure injection.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Modular and partner/acquired integrations can create incident ownership ambiguity.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Failure is detected; owner is unambiguous; degraded behavior is understood; no silent data loss; recovery reconciles state.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Change routing, WFM/QM configuration, case workflow and VA/agentic behavior in controlled scope; validate and revert.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Change history, approvals, test results, version artifacts and recovery logs.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Critical changes occur directly in live state without acceptable preview, rollback or audit.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which configuration changes are safely promoted, and which are edited directly in production?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Test/non-production environment where available, regression suite, named approvers and representative configs.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: A complete cross-product sandbox/version/promotion/rollback model is not publicly established.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Buyer can test before broad impact, identify versions/owners and recover/revert predictably.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Map every required module/integration/carrier against contractual SLA, RTO/RPO, support target and degraded-mode behavior.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Contract/SLA schedule, architecture dependency map and failure/fallback runbook.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: A critical journey relies on an uncontracted/lower-SLA dependency without acceptable continuity.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which required service has a lower SLA than core Puzzel Contact Centre, and what happens to the customer journey when it fails?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Buyer critical journey map and proposed contract/SKUs.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Public 99.99% PCC and 99.9% other-service figures may not cover the buyer's end-to-end dependency chain.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: End-to-end availability assumptions are contractually explicit and failure of a lower-SLA dependency has an accepted fallback.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Quote base/peak/high-automation scenarios for Co-Pilot, Live Summary, VA, CI/QM plus telephony and human fallback.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Quote, unit definitions, scenario model and usage reports.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Material unmetered/opaque driver or peak/high-AI cost exceeds tolerance.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: What is the marginal fully loaded cost of moving the next 10% of interactions into Puzzel AI?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Buyer volumes, AI adoption, containment/action rates, languages, seasonality and quote.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Public pricing does not expose full AI unit economics.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: All usage units and add-ons are identifiable, forecastable and remain within buyer threshold across scenarios.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Validate numbering, carrier/SIP design, emergency services, outbound CLI, recording, porting and failover for every required country.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Country matrix, carrier design, test calls, port plan and failover results.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Unsupported requirement or unacceptable carrier/porting/failover dependency.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which buyer countries require an alternate carrier or materially different Puzzel operating model?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Country/number inventory and existing carrier architecture.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: European telephony strength does not prove every buyer country/number/porting requirement.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: All countries meet service/regulatory/cutover requirements with accepted ownership and lead times.
